gold_rationale: The molecule carries aromatic nitro and aromatic amine (aniline) structural alerts and is AMES-positive/genotoxic with likely reactive-metabolite formation. For a chronic, lifelong CNS indication in an older population, mutagenicity is a fundamental, typically disqualifying liability that good CNS penetration and target potency do not offset. The correct decision is No-Go (at most a Conditional Go strictly contingent on scaffold/series redesign that removes the nitro/aniline alerts and clears genotoxicity). Potency and brain penetration must not drive a Go past a genotoxicity signal.
required_concepts: aromatic nitro and aromatic amine structural alerts
chronic lifelong dosing makes genotoxicity disqualifying
good potency / CNS penetration does not offset genotoxicity
scaffold redesign to remove the alerts
red_flags: issues a Go despite an AMES-positive / genotoxic signal
lets good CNS penetration or potency override the mutagenicity liability
fails to recognize the nitro / aniline genotoxicity structural alerts
ignores that chronic lifelong dosing makes genotoxicity disqualifying
